parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of tasks to display per page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- **INITIALIZING**: init.
- **WAITING**: pending scheduling.
- **IN_PROGRESS**: running.
- **COMPLETED**: completed.
- **CANCELLING**: being canceled.
- **CANCELLED**: canceled.
- **REMOVING**: being deleted.
- **TIMED_OUT**: timed out.
